title: Decision Regarding Copyright and Related Rights No. 0439/MOIC, Dated 30 March 2023
text:
The Ministry of Industry and Commerce issued Decision Regarding Copyright and Related Rights No. 0439/MOIC, dated 30 March 2023 to establish principles and regulations governing the enforcement of copyright and related rights, including copyright notification, representation, collective copyright organizations, and copyright management organizations. The decision aims to ensure the consistent implementation of intellectual property law nationwide and to support the country’s socio-economic development.
